'[This] Agreement and information contained therein IS NOT for use or disclosure outside of AT&T, its Affiliates, and third party representatives, and Vendor except under written agreement by the contracting parties.' A reader scanning for modality could take it for a MUST_NOT. It is NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING on TWO independent grounds, either sufficient: its subject is 'This Agreement and information contained therein', a THING (section 3.5), and 'is not for use or disclosure' is COPULAR STATUS (section 8.8) -- and it is furniture besides (section 8.7), a legend stamped on 35 of C03's segments rather than a clause of the agreement.

That is the near-identical construction to this clause's 'each Party shall bear its own fees and expenses'.
